checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Exactly one white leather sneaker is shown.
Background plain white, no scenery or props.
must.why: White background with only faint shadow and slight off-white haze at edges.

must.item: Entire shoe visible with space around it.
must.why: Whole shoe in frame with margins, though right toe and left heel are moderately close to the edges.

must.item: No promotional text, badges or graphic borders.

Shoe is low-contrast white on white, and the shadow is slightly dark under the toe.

summary: A clean square image of one white leather sneaker at an angle on a near-white background with a soft shadow, and only minor background tint and AI-look issues.
